sources.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: render-locked four-view architectural construction board for a CityPrompt LEGO building variant
Primary request: Design one coherent, physically buildable Food Hall - Historic Iron and Glass Market from the catalogue contract below and show that exact same building in four equal panels in a precise 2 by 2 grid.
Panel 1: dead-front orthographic elevation, complete building visible. Panel 2: pedestrian-height front-right architectural survey oblique. Panel 3: rear-left oblique proving every material and structural system wraps the secondary elevations. Panel 4: high aerial roof-plan oblique proving roof topology, courts, spans, and equipment.
Catalogue contract: A restored nineteenth-century market hall forms three connected barrel-vaulted iron-and-glass aisles above a red-brick and honey-stone base, with exposed wrought-iron arches, clerestory lanterns, operable end fans, deep arcaded entrances and visible occupied market stalls.
Building lock: 68 m by 42 m, one principal market floor plus a narrow mezzanine; three parallel barrel-vaulted aisles share brick party piers and continuous valleys, fourteen exposed iron arch frames carry the glass, each front gable owns a real radial fanlight and arched entry, and warm stalls remain visible through the clear end walls.
Scene/backdrop: clean warm-light-grey architectural studio ground and backdrop, no neighbors, trees, cars or people.
Style/medium: premium photoreal architectural survey photography and physically plausible construction reference, not concept art.
Lighting/mood: neutral bright overcast survey illumination with soft contact shadows and controlled glass reflections, consistent in every panel.
Materials/textures: weathered red stock brick; honey sandstone spring blocks and plinth; dark green-black wrought and cast iron; slender bronze glazing bars; lightly rippled clear roof glass; warm occupied market-hall depth; patinated zinc ridge caps and stone paving.
Constraints: exact same coherent building topology, storey datums, structural bays, openings, entrances, material zones and roof in all four panels; credible load paths; real recessed openings and physical screens; thin neutral gutters; whole building in every frame; no labels, text, signs, logos or watermark.
Avoid: Markthal inhabited arch, generic warehouse shed, one opaque barrel roof, black window wallpaper, missing valleys, sealed entrances, modern shopping mall; perspective distortion, blank sides, changed geometry between panels, entourage, dramatic sunset.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: shadow-neutral 3 by 2 construction and occupied-depth material board for the exact Food Hall - Historic Iron and Glass Market shown in Image 1
Input images: Image 1 is the approved four-view geometry, palette, construction-scale and optical authority.
Primary request: Create six equal square straight-on orthographic samples in a precise 3-column by 2-row grid separated only by thin neutral-grey gutters, with no labels.
Top-left: weathered red stock brick with lime mortar, authentic construction scale and fine micro-detail, no facade or opening.
Top-center: honey sandstone plinth springer and sill, authentic construction scale and fine micro-detail, no complete building element.
Top-right: dark green black wrought iron truss and column, authentic construction scale and fine micro-detail, no complete ornament assembly.
Bottom-left: slender aged bronze glazing bar, authentic construction scale and fine micro-detail, no complete frame, door or screen.
Bottom-center: lightly rippled clear market-hall glass plus clean occupied depth seen dead-on, with clear floor, ceiling and restrained warm occupation, no exterior frame, mullion, screen, facade or skewed perspective.
Bottom-right: patinated zinc ridge cap and flashing, authentic construction scale and evenly lit, no complete roof scene.
Scene/backdrop: flat evenly lit material-capture setup. Style/medium: premium physically based photoreal architectural construction texture reference.
Lighting: diffuse neutral overcast capture; no directional sunlight, baked shadow, vignette or perspective.
Constraints: exact 3 by 2 grid; every sample fills its cell edge-to-edge; no labels, text, logos or watermark; no complete facade or repeated window grid; match Image 1 exactly.
Avoid: cartoon materials, generic substitutions, oversized motifs, blue mirror glass, dramatic lighting, building perspective, decorative border.
